name: Sıfır Bir
description: The story of a group of young people who live in Adana – Hürriyet District got involved in illegal businesses and became Adana's strongest gang over time. The series, which started as an independent production in 2016 and broadcast on Youtube, has been transferred to Blutv with all its episodes as of the 3rd season.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The gang is formed under the leadership of Savaş.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: First fight: Drugs.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Savaş brings order to the neighborhood. People in the neighborhood respect to Savaş.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Revenge has its price.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Özgür is set free from prison. A big raid is taking place.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After the raid, Savas and his friends settled in the safe house. The neighborhood is entrusted to the youth.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gang' biggest enemy Seyfi is released from prison.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Cio received into prison.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Anafor begins to get closer to Hülya. Savaş and his gang empower themself to work.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The big attack that Seyfi planned takes place. A bloodiest raid is bound to happen.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The attack on the wedding in the neighborhood brings great destruction with it. As Özgür questions their destiny, Cio's anger overflows. Savaş has to make strategic decisions....

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After the great loss, tension in the neighborhood is increasing.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Savaş, Cio and Özgür try to find the person who helps Seyfi, they also prepare their revenge plans.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Savaş and his gang reorganize within themselves, unexpected events happen in the prison.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Savaş and Cihat eventually find Seyfi. However, there are some new developments that they don't take into account for their revenge plans.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Seyfi's gang goes out into the street. Conflicts begin between the two gangs.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: One Day!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The bigger they come, the harder they fall...

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Savaş and his gang, who took their revenge from Seyfi, were sent to a different prison. Hearing that Cengo and Burak, who are among Seyfi's men, are in the same prison, the gang is preparing to punish these young people for betraying themselves.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Savaş and his gang, who continue their war against drug dealers, will draw the reaction of many prisoners, especially some of the guards, while trying to prevent drug trafficking inside the prison.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Gökhan is released. They meet with Cihat in the neighborhood and plan to take back control of the neighborhood. Things will get even more complicated in prison.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As Yahya puts his plan into action against Savaş and his gang, outside members of the gang take action to reclaim their neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: When Sami threw Cengo and Burak to the wolves, the duo made a new plan and told Savaş about everything they know about Savas' enemies. Yahya and Necip realized how dangerous their new enemy Savaş could be.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After Tümer's death, Savaş and his gang swear for revenge. Necip is afraid that he will be exposed due to the confusion in prison. Nobody will be comfortable anymore, neither inside nor outside.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Cihat Sarsılmaz ambushed and killed Cengiz and his men. Sami suffers from losing his number one man and his nephew Cengiz. After this time, all Sami wants is to kill as many people as possible from the other side.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Having just gotten out of prison, Savaş, Cio and Özgür are aware of the threat that will come by Sami. For this reason, the trio, who decided to have a meeting with the elders of the neighborhood, was disappointed about Gökhan's attitude. Gökhan, who displayed a humiliating attitude towards the young people of the neighborhood, saw a reaction from Cio, causing tension at the meeting. There is strict control in the prison. Necip can no longer carry out his business. Savaş, on the other hand, captured the hidden camera footage of Necip's malpractices and got a great trump card.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Sami, who killed Burak and Cengo's brother, has disturbed the balance of the neighborhood, while Cengiz's father is preparing to take action for revenge in Adana, where he came from illegal ways. Necip, on the other hand, is pondering how to get rid of the trouble caused by the Savaş.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: A new partner is included in Sami's plans. After the death of his son Cengiz, Salim who came from illegal ways in Turkey, is holding responsible Sami for his sons death. The gang, which only has a trump card to use against Necip, is left helpless in the plans of Yahya and his gang.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Savaş and his gang, who fought a great fight against the drug lord Sami, are preparing to g oto a real war this time. Savaş and his gang, will take action against Sami and the people who killed their friends in order to avenge Özgür in the season finale.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: After his losses, Savaş decides to stay away from the neighborhood for a while to rest. However, after Cio's death is revealed, the neighborhood gets mixed up and Savaş returns to the neighborhood after a long time. Sami's brother Salim and his friends are planning their last and biggest attack on the Hürriyet District.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Savas, who killed Salim, is arrested and send to prison. In the neighborhood, a great chaos occurs after the events that took place. Savaş is in the prison, while Cihat and Gökhan are fighting outside.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Gökhan makes a big move by turning his casino idea into reality. Meanwhile, the enemies plan a new attack on the Hürriyet District. Savaş is faced with the tormented days of the prison warden and the chief guard as he tells the inspector who comes to the prison everything that goes on in the prison. Savaş, on the other hand, comes together with his ward mates and make plans to counter this cruelty and persecution.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: While Savaş and Azad are transferred to another prison where much worse conditions prevail, Nesih and his friends, who are betrayed by Necip, cause chaos in the prison. As Gökhan and Cihat devise new plans against their enemies, Cihat's cousin Abbas comes to visit Cihat.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Burak and Cengo will be questioned by Gökhan as a result of their fight with Ozi. This situation will further strain the nerves already tense because of Gökhan. On the other hand, Savaş and Azad, who don’t want to have drugs in their new prison ward, will make many enemies.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Difficult times await Savaş, due to the war he started against drugs in prison.  Savaş and Azad confronted Zahit and his men. On the other hand, Burak and Cengo, by force of taking money from Gökhan's loan shark friend, will cause their relations with Gökhan to be further strained.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The mistakes made by Gökhan will gradually begin to be noticed by those in the neighborhood and by Nesih. Gökhan, who gets the news of all this, will want to set his own rules and will cause separations. Savaş, who openly declares his rules to Zahit and Necat, will fall into the middle of a brand new conflict that will take place in prison.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: With the discovery of Doğan's body, Gökhan's true face is revealed. Gökhan plans an attack on the gang to protect himself. Cahit learns the ugly truth about his cousin Abbas from Bengü. In prison, Zahit and Necat carry out the attack they have planned for a long time against Savaş.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Cihat and Sero were caught by the police and sent to prison. Savaş struggles to survive in the hospital. The gang, which was attacked by Gökhan, returned to the neighborhood to recover after heavy losses. The neighborhood is now entrusted to Burak and Cengo.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Savaş, who leaves the hospital, is sent to the prison where Cihat is. Cihat and Savaş plan to end the war first inside and then outside. Nesih, whose pregnant wife was killed by Ozi, is burning with revenge. Gökhan will continue to attack the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Having a hard time outside, the gang is shaken by the death of Nesih. The pressure of Gökhan and the death of Nesih make the 	neighborhood residents stand against Burak and Cengo. Cihat and Savaş begin to implement their plans to set the things right again.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Savaş and Cihat escape from prison with the gang. Returning to the neighborhood, Savaş will raid the place where Gökhan is hiding.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Gökhan survived the raid. Savaş and Cihat will move against Gökhan's collaborators and drive him into a corner. With the death of his best friend, Berto takes action to avenge his revenge.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Realizing that he will not be comfortable in Adana as long as Savaş lives, Gökhan decides to gather his men and attack Savaş. On the other hand, Savaş continues to search for Gökhan everywhere. Berto begins to act alone to avenge his best friend Anfor.
